title: Key usage
description: View usage and limits for your virtual key.
keyHelp: Your key stays in this browser tab.
invalidKey: This key is invalid or expired.
loadFailed: Unable to load key information. Please try again.
usageDescription: Recorded requests for this key in the selected period.
noModels: No model usage in this period.
loggingDisabled: Usage statistics are unavailable because logging is disabled.
limitsDescription: Limits attached to this key. Shared limits may also apply.
providerBalancesDescription: Current balances reported by DeepSeek or OpenRouter. OpenRouter requires a management key; other providers do not expose a balance through this view.
providerBalanceTotalsOmitted: Totals are hidden when a provider has multiple allowed accounts; its API may report one shared account balance for each key.
noProviderBalances: No real provider balances are available for this key.
noLimits: No limits are configured for this key.
priceDisclaimer: Costs use recorded prices and may be incomplete.
